card.line: Naioth in Ramah was a place where Samuel led a group of prophets, and where David took shelter from King Saul.

moments.title: David Hides with Samuel
moments.text: David ran away from Saul and told Samuel everything Saul had done to him. Then David and Samuel went to Naioth and stayed there.

moments.title: Saul's Messengers Prophesy
moments.text: Saul sent messengers to seize David, but the Spirit of God came upon them and they prophesied. He sent more messengers a second and a third time, and they prophesied as well.

moments.title: Saul Prophesies at Naioth
moments.text: Saul went to Naioth himself, and the Spirit of God came upon him too. He prophesied, took off his robes, and lay there all day and night.

moments.title: David Leaves Naioth
moments.text: David fled from Naioth in Ramah and went to Jonathan. He asked what he had done wrong that Saul wanted to take his life.

problems.problem: Naioth is still labeled a city in the place designation; the verses and sources establish only that it was a place in or near Ramah.
